title: Copilot Studio: discover and use shared plugins from Microsoft's plugin registry
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, documented controls and billing statements are supported. It distinguishes existing plugin administration from the planned registry integration and limits unpublished pricing claims to registry discovery or adding a plugin.

claims.quote: Copilot Studio now connects to Microsoft's shared plugin registry, making it easier for makers to discover and use plugins, connectors, and other available capabilities.
